text:
sara_ml: quick sync — final checklist for phoenix-7b staging canary. need: canonical weights path, tokenizer sanity (emoji + unk tokens), config validation, and a short golden/toolcall smoke. cc @mike_serving @liam_qc :eyes:

mike_serving: weights are at gs://redwood-models/phoenix/phoenix-7b/v2/weights.tar.gz. config in S3: s3://redwood-configs/phoenix/phoenix-7b-v2.json. i ran the config lint locally — only thing was batch_size defaulting to 8 (we want 4 for latency). i'll push a patch to pin batch_size and add the kv_cache flags. :white_check_mark:

liam_qc: heads up — tokenizer has a weird behavior with zero-width joiner (ZWJ) sequences and flag emojis. our golden set includes a few emoji-heavy prompts; on staging tokens sometimes split into multiple UNKs. quick repro: input "I love 🇯🇵 sushi" -> tokenizer returns: ["I", "Ġlove", "Ġ", "UNK", "Ġsushi"]. i can add a small tokenization shim in the tokenizer config to normalize ZWJ sequences or patch the gold prompts to avoid edge-case combos. leaning towards shim.

jess_ops: for the canary policy, do we want a traffic slice with low-latency constraint? also need to confirm autoscale min_replicas=2 for dedicated pools or the canary will spin cold and timeout. cc @mike_serving for runtime flags.

mike_serving: yes — canary traffic slice: 2% traffic, latency_slo=150ms p95, min_replicas=2. i'm adding an override in the rollout object. also enabling fallback route to phoenix-7b-quant if cpu gets overloaded.

liam_qc: ran the toolcall smoke for the structured output path. failing example attached (small snippet):

```
toolcall response (staging):
{"tool": "open_retrieval", "result": "{\"items\": null,}"}
```

The extra trailing comma breaks our JSON parsing in the eval harness. this is reproducible when the model returns empty lists. suggested fixes: 1) stricter structured output schema that tolerates null/[] and strips trailing commas server-side, or 2) a post-processor in the eval harness that cleans up the JSON string before parsing. i'd prefer (2) for short term.

natalie_re: adding two golden prompts that exercise tool calling + structured outputs. one focuses on empty-retrieval behavior, one on nested tool calls. examples: 
- "Find citations for 'cold fusion' — return tool call only if there are >0 results, otherwise return {\"tool\": \"none\"}"
- "Summarize the conversation and call sentiment_tool with fields: score, category"

sara_ml: thanks. @liam_qc please add the post-processor patch to the eval harness and run a quick golden sweep (<=50 prompts) — can you post results here by EOD? also mike, once you push the config patch ping the canary job.

liam_qc: on it. will run sweep and include tokenization edge-case checks (emoji + ZWJ). will report failures as short bullets.

mike_serving: pushed config patch to branch "phoenix/v2-canary-config". deploy-bot: please start canary with rollout=phoenix/v2-canary-config, slice=2%.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed for branch phoenix/v2-canary-config. starting canary: slice=2%, min_replicas=2, latency_slo=150ms. note: model artifact download estimated 35s for first replica. :rocket:

jess_ops: reminder — smoke test should include an embed/kv-cache warmup step to avoid cold-start token spikes. add a small warmup script in the canary job (2 requests of varying lengths).

sara_ml: perfect. if the golden sweep shows >5% regression on any metric (struct_parsing, toolcall_success, or p95 latency) we abort and roll back automatically. otherwise proceed to 10% ramp. thanks team :pray:
